data: What is the time for the "T-TA_sts' in all number of words?

The caption indicates that the figure shows average running times of each model according to the number of words on STS and reranking tasks. The question asks for the time for the "T-TA_sts" in all number of words. From the figure, we can see that the orange line represents T-TA_sts. The y-axis represents time in seconds, and the x-axis represents the number of words. The orange line starts at approximately 0.05 seconds and increases gradually with the number of words. Therefore, the time for T-TA_sts increases as the number of words increases.
